EARLIER SCENES (context only):
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。
CURRENT SCENE:
他觉得，这种一定是做药的花。原来他想错了。吃了以后，神农快生病。 这时一个穿着蓝色衣服的人帮神农，快给他一种红的灵芝。神农吃了以后，他没有病，想起来以前一个人告诉他，灵芝对身体有好处。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P310] 这种【^】一定是做药的花
  proposed by the correction model: 这种[+花]一定是做药的花
  her past correction (collocation_selection): 和这个花[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction (measure_word_choice): 他正好吃[一毒→一种有毒]的花
  her past correction (collocation_selection): 有的花[是毒→有毒]
  rule card collocation_selection: Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.
  rule card measure_word_choice: Use the appropriate measure word before the noun: 这/那 + Measure word + noun. Use noun-specific measure words such as 棵 for trees, and 位 is a polite MW. Not an error: Do not use 位 for a child in this context; 位 is a polite MW. 本+N. is usually used in formal advertisement/news and may indicate that the author owns the noun.

[P311] 神农【^】快生病
  proposed by the AI checker: 神农[+很]快生病 (很快 means “soon”; 快 alone is not natural here)
  her past correction (perception_look_see): 神农[看了→看到了]很多生病的人 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦神农⟧看到很多人生病了 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
  her past correction (le_completed): 所以神农吃[+了]以后就生病了 — her note: 了completed
  rule card perception_look_see: 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing. Not an error: Do not flag 看 when the meaning is only “look,” rather than successfully seeing something. 看到 does not always need 了.
  rule card first_mention_introduction: When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific. Not an error: After a character has already been introduced, this rule does not require another brief introduction.

[P312] 神农快生病【^】
  proposed by the AI checker: 神农快生病[+了] (the illness began after the completed action)
  proposed by the correction model: 神农快生病[+了]
  her past correction (le_completed): 所以神农吃[+了]以后就生病了 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (perception_look_see): 神农[看了→看到了]很多生病的人 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction (no_le_with_mei): 神农没死[-了] — her note: 没+ V.
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.
  rule card perception_look_see: 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing. Not an error: Do not flag 看 when the meaning is only “look,” rather than successfully seeing something. 看到 does not always need 了.

[P313] 【快】给他一种红的灵芝

Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.

[P315] 快给他【一种】红的灵芝

[P316] 他【没有病】
  proposed by the AI checker: 他[没有病→的病好了] (病好了 means that his illness recovered)
  her past correction (no_le_with_mei): 和他[没病了→病好了] — her note: 没 +V., no了, the verb is an action verb
  her past correction (non_adjective_degree_patterns): [然后，不病→就好了] — her note: “病” is not a normal Adj., so it cannot be with 很 or 不
  her past correction (he_scope_coordination): [-和]他没病了 — her note: 和cannot link clauses
  rule card no_le_with_mei: After 没/没有 with an action verb for an action that did not happen, use 没 + V. and do not add 了. Not an error: This rule is for 没/没有 + an action verb. Do not apply it when the word after 没 is not an action verb, as in 没病了.
  rule card non_adjective_degree_patterns: “病” and “生病” are not normal Adj., so do not use 很 or 不 directly with them. To show degree, use 病得很厉害 or 病得很重.

快 alone is not natural before 生病.
It marks the resulting change of state.
快 is not natural in this narrative verb phrase.
The giving is a completed narrative action.
